description: This file implements input handling classes for Firefox in the Playwright project, including keyboard, mouse, and touchscreen input event dispatching.

classes.name: RawKeyboardImpl
classes.description: Implements raw keyboard input handling for Firefox, including key down, key up, and text input.

classes.name: RawMouseImpl
classes.description: Handles raw mouse input events such as move, down, up, wheel, and associates with a page.

methods.name: toFirefoxKeyDescription
methods.description: Overrides certain key descriptions with Firefox-specific key codes.

methods.name: toModifiersMask
methods.description: Converts a set of keyboard modifiers to a bitmask.

methods.name: toButtonNumber
methods.description: Converts mouse button string to a numeric code.

methods.name: toButtonsMask
methods.description: Converts a set of mouse buttons to a bitmask.
